package decisionfixture

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	decision "github.com/ruipengliu/lerna/components/decision_engine"
	v "github.com/ruipengliu/lerna/contract/v1_1"
)

type final01ProposalOutput struct {
	Key       string         `json:"key"`
	Ref       v.ContentRef   `json:"ref"`
	Body      string         `json:"body"`
	Sources   []v.ContentRef `json:"sources"`
	Published bool           `json:"published"`
}

type final01ProposalCase struct {
	Name              string                  `json:"name"`
	SourceSchema      string                  `json:"source_schema"`
	DecisionSchema    string                  `json:"decision_schema"`
	SourceOwner       v.OwnerRef              `json:"source_owner"`
	Request           json.RawMessage         `json:"request"`
	Subject           json.RawMessage         `json:"subject"`
	GetRequest        json.RawMessage         `json:"get_request"`
	CommandGetRequest json.RawMessage         `json:"command_get_request"`
	Receipt           json.RawMessage         `json:"receipt"`
	DecisionBefore    json.RawMessage         `json:"decision_before"`
	LeaseUntil        time.Time               `json:"lease_until"`
	Outputs           []final01ProposalOutput `json:"outputs"`
	WritersDrained    bool                    `json:"writers_drained"`
}

type final01ProposalReady struct {
	Protocol string                `json:"protocol"`
	Cases    []final01ProposalCase `json:"cases"`
}

// The driver changes no frozen production file and never writes a business
// record or prepared object. States come from the original public Component
// and real Source. Schema descriptors and Close are mechanical lifecycle data.
type final01ProposalPublisher struct {
	decision.Publisher
	outputs []final01ProposalOutput
	mode    string
	cancel  context.CancelFunc
}

func (p *final01ProposalPublisher) PlanPublication(ctx context.Context, key string, body []byte, sources []v.ContentRef, permission decision.Permission) (v.ContentRef, error) {
	ref, err := p.Publisher.PlanPublication(ctx, key, body, sources, permission)
	if err == nil {
		p.outputs = append(p.outputs, final01ProposalOutput{Key: key, Ref: ref, Body: string(body), Sources: append([]v.ContentRef{}, sources...)})
	}
	return ref, err
}

func (p *final01ProposalPublisher) Publish(ctx context.Context, key string, body []byte, sources []v.ContentRef, permission decision.Permission) (v.ContentRef, error) {
	if p.mode == "prepared_waiting" {
		return v.ContentRef{}, errors.New("finite independent publisher unavailable before commit")
	}
	ref, err := p.Publisher.Publish(ctx, key, body, sources, permission)
	if err == nil && p.mode == "publication_running" && strings.HasSuffix(key, "/artifact") {
		p.cancel()
	}
	return ref, err
}

func TestFrozenFinal01ProposalWriter(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ready := final01ProposalReady{Protocol: "lerna-final01-proposal-upgrade-1", Cases: []final01ProposalCase{}}
	for _, name := range []string{"accepted", "running", "prepared_waiting", "publication_running", "completed", "failed"} {
		world := NewWorld(t, ctx)
		scene := world.Scenario()
		scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxRuleSteps = "1"
		scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxCost.IntegerValue = "1"
		if name == "running" {
			scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxRuleSteps = "2"
			scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxCost.IntegerValue = "2"
		}
		if name == "failed" {
			scene.Request.Payload.Limits.MaxRuleSteps = "0"
		}
		interrupted, interrupt := context.WithCancel(ctx)
		publisher := &final01ProposalPublisher{Publisher: world.Source(), mode: name, cancel: interrupt}
		service, err := decision.New(decision.Config{Owner: v.OwnerRef{TenantID: scene.DecisionRef.TenantID, OwnerID: scene.DecisionRef.OwnerID}, Store: world.Store(), Authority: world.Source(), Source: world.Source(), Publisher: publisher, Component: scene.Request.Payload.ComponentRef, Worker: "original-final01-proposal-writer", Lease: time.Second, PoolControl: true})
		if err != nil {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		request, err := v.Encode(scene.Request)
		if err != nil {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		outcome, err := service.Decide(ctx, request, &scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		received, ok := outcome.AsReceived()
		if !ok {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal("original producer did not receive its command")
		}
		if _, ok := received.Receipt.AsAccepted(); !ok {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal("original producer did not accept its input")
		}
		old := final01ProposalCase{Name: name, SourceSchema: world.SourceWorld.cfg.Schema, DecisionSchema: world.Config().Schema, SourceOwner: world.SourceWorld.owner, Request: request, GetRequest: scene.GetJSON, CommandGetRequest: scene.CommandGetJSON, Outputs: []final01ProposalOutput{}}
		old.Subject, err = v.Encode(scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		old.Receipt, err = v.Encode(received.Receipt)
		if err != nil {
			interrupt()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		switch name {
		case "running", "publication_running":
			claim, err := service.Claim(ctx)
			if err != nil || claim == nil {
				interrupt()
				t.Fatal("original claim missing", err)
			}
			old.LeaseUntil = claim.Claim.LeaseUntil
			if name == "running" {
				started, err := service.Start(ctx, claim.Claim)
				if err != nil || started == nil || !started.Compute {
					interrupt()
					t.Fatal("original durable start missing", err)
				}
			} else if err := service.RunClaim(interrupted, claim.Claim); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
				interrupt()
				t.Fatal("original publication boundary did not interrupt", err)
			}
		case "prepared_waiting", "completed", "failed":
			if _, err := service.Step(ctx); err != nil {
				interrupt()
				t.Fatal("original finite worker", err)
			}
		}
		interrupt()
		view, err := service.Get(ctx, scene.GetJSON, &scene.Subject)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		found, ok := view.AsFound()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("original produced Decision missing")
		}
		old.DecisionBefore, err = v.Encode(found.Decision)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		switch name {
		case "accepted":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsAccepted(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("original accepted state missing")
			}
		case "running", "publication_running":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsRunning(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("original running state missing")
			}
		case "prepared_waiting":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsWaiting(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("original saved handoff did not wait")
			}
		case "completed":
			if _, ok := found.Decision.AsCompleted(); !ok {
				t.Fatal("original completion missing")
			}
		case "failed":
			if failed, ok := found.Decision.AsFailed(); !ok || failed.Failure != "rule_limit_exceeded" {
				t.Fatal("original bounded failure missing")
			}
		}
		permission, err := world.Source().Authorize(ctx, scene.Subject, scene.DecisionRef, "get", nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, output := range publisher.outputs {
			body, err := world.Source().ReadPublished(ctx, output.Ref, permission)
			if err == nil {
				if string(body) != output.Body {
					t.Fatal("original independent body changed")
				}
				output.Published = true
			} else if !errors.Is(err, decision.ErrForbidden) {
				t.Fatal("original publication readback", err)
			}
			old.Outputs = append(old.Outputs, output)
		}
		// No old worker loop or callback remains. Retain only exact-scope admins
		// until the new consumer explicitly closes all holders and releases us.
		if err := world.Store().Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal("original Decision writer closure", err)
		}
		world.store = nil
		if err := world.Source().Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal("original Source writer closure", err)
		}
		world.SourceWorld.source = nil
		old.WritersDrained = true
		ready.Cases = append(ready.Cases, old)
	}
	frame, err := json.Marshal(ready)
	if err != nil || len(frame) > 128*1024 {
		t.Fatal("finite original ready frame", err)
	}
	fmt.Println("LERNA_LEGACY_READY " + string(frame))
	line := make(chan string, 1)
	scanDone := make(chan struct{})
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := os.Stdin.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Error("original release pipe closure", err)
		}
		select {
		case <-scanDone:
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			t.Error("original release scanner exit unconfirmed")
		}
	})
	go func() {
		defer close(scanDone)
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 128), 1024)
		if scanner.Scan() {
			line <- scanner.Text()
		} else {
			line <- ""
		}
	}()
	select {
	case request := <-line:
		if request != "RELEASE" {
			// Ready transferred responsibility to the current consumer. Missing
			// release cannot authorize the original worlds' schema-drop cleanup.
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "original administrator release missing; retain acknowledged scopes")
			os.Exit(2)
		}
	case <-ctx.Done():
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "original administrator release deadline; retain acknowledged scopes")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}
